findings.title: Journal failure before termination can bypass cleanup
findings.disposition: Static source-supported failure path; not an observed escaped workload. Withhold all-path cancellation/deadline/cleanup guarantees. Future repair must make termination/lease cleanup independent of journal availability, then independently inject STOP_REQUESTED journal/fsync failure while a benign worker is live.

findings.title: Concurrent starts can overwrite launcher ownership
findings.disposition: No concurrent-start reproduction executed. A later separately authorized deterministic visit must use one serialized launcher lifecycle per runtime state with model gate disabled. Future repair requires an interprocess lifecycle lock and readiness bound to exact child identity, then synchronized-start recheck.

findings.title: Readiness-failure drain can wait indefinitely after unconfirmed termination
findings.disposition: Static unexercised failure path. Existing UNKNOWN fixture killed process then withheld confirmation; it did not retain a live process/open pipe. Withhold all-path bounded readiness settlement. Future bounded-drain/quarantine repair requires independent live-open-pipe benign recheck.

findings.title: Completed answers retain contradictory route/progress notices
findings.disposition: CODE independently agrees with VISION. Actual backend disposition and model payload label are separate and correct; surrounding badge/queued notice are misleading. Future repair must bind notices to operation and distinguish displayed-result route from next-request route, preserving session fencing.
